1	"""
2	Retroactive coregistration quality assessment from already-processed pairs.
3	
4	Reads existing ifg_goldstein.tif + coherence.tif for each processed pair and
5	computes lightweight quality metrics without re-running coregistration.
6	
7	Usage
8	-----
9	python scripts/assess_coreg_quality.py \
10	    --pairs_dir data/processed/pairs \
11	    --out_csv   data/manifests/coreg_quality.csv
12	"""
13	
14	import argparse
15	import json
16	import logging
17	from pathlib import Path
18	
19	import numpy as np
20	import pandas as pd
21	import rasterio
22	
23	logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s")
24	log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
25	
26	
27	def assess_pair(pair_dir: Path) -> dict | None:
28	    """
29	    Compute quality metrics for one processed pair.
30	
31	    Returns a dict with per-pair metrics, or None if files are missing.
32	    """
33	    ifg_path = pair_dir / "ifg_goldstein.tif"
34	    coh_path = pair_dir / "coherence.tif"
35	    meta_path = pair_dir / "coreg_meta.json"
36	
37	    if not ifg_path.exists() or not coh_path.exists():
38	        return None
39	
40	    # Load coherence
41	    with rasterio.open(coh_path) as src:
42	        coh = src.read(1).astype(np.float32)
43	
44	    # Load interferogram (Re + Im)
45	    with rasterio.open(ifg_path) as src:
46	        re = src.read(1).astype(np.float32)
47	        im = src.read(2).astype(np.float32)
48	
49	    ifg_phase = np.arctan2(im, re)  # wrapped phase
50	
51	    # Coherent pixel mask (coh > 0.2)
52	    coherent = coh > 0.2
53	
54	    mean_coh = float(coh.mean())
55	    coh_p10 = float(np.percentile(coh, 10))
56	
57	    # Wrapped phase std over coherent pixels (proxy for fringe density vs. noise)
58	    if coherent.sum() > 100:
59	        phase_std = float(ifg_phase[coherent].std())
60	    else:
61	        phase_std = float("nan")
62	
63	    # Read existing coreg offsets from metadata (if available)
64	    row_offset = None
65	    col_offset = None
66	    cc_peak_mean = None
67	    n_coreg_patches = None
68	    if meta_path.exists():
69	        try:
70	            with open(meta_path) as f:
71	                meta = json.load(f)
72	            row_offset = meta.get("row_offset_px")
73	            col_offset = meta.get("col_offset_px")
74	            cc_peak_mean = meta.get("cc_peak_mean")
75	            n_coreg_patches = meta.get("n_coreg_patches")
76	        except Exception:
77	            pass
78	
79	    return {
80	        "pair_dir":         pair_dir.name,
81	        "mean_coherence":   mean_coh,
82	        "coherence_p10":    coh_p10,
83	        "phase_spatial_std": phase_std,
84	        "n_coherent_px":    int(coherent.sum()),
85	        "row_offset_px":    row_offset,
86	        "col_offset_px":    col_offset,
87	        "cc_peak_mean":     cc_peak_mean,
88	        "n_coreg_patches":  n_coreg_patches,
89	    }
90	
91	
92	def main() -> None:
93	    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Retroactive coregistration quality assessment.")
94	    p.add_argument("--pairs_dir", required=True, help="Root dir with per-pair subdirectories")
95	    p.add_argument("--out_csv", default="data/manifests/coreg_quality.csv",
96	                   help="Output CSV path")
97	    p.add_argument("--coh_flag_threshold", type=float, default=0.15,
98	                   help="Flag pairs with mean_coherence below this value")
99	    args = p.parse_args()
100	
101	    pairs_dir = Path(args.pairs_dir)
102	    pair_dirs = sorted(d for d in pairs_dir.iterdir() if d.is_dir())
103	    log.info("Found %d pair directories", len(pair_dirs))
104	
105	    rows = []
106	    for pd_dir in pair_dirs:
107	        result = assess_pair(pd_dir)
108	        if result is None:
109	            log.debug("Skipping %s (missing files)", pd_dir.name)
110	            continue
111	        rows.append(result)
112	
113	    if not rows:
114	        log.error("No valid pairs found in %s", pairs_dir)
115	        return
116	
117	    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
118	
119	    # Flag low-coherence pairs
120	    df["flag_low_coherence"] = df["mean_coherence"] < args.coh_flag_threshold
121	
122	    # Summary
123	    log.info("Assessed %d pairs", len(df))
124	    log.info("  mean coherence:  %.3f ± %.3f", df["mean_coherence"].mean(), df["mean_coherence"].std())
125	    log.info("  coherence P10:   %.3f", df["coherence_p10"].mean())
126	    log.info("  phase_spatial_std: %.3f ± %.3f (rad)",
127	             df["phase_spatial_std"].mean(), df["phase_spatial_std"].std())
128	    log.info("  low-coherence flags (< %.2f): %d / %d",
129	             args.coh_flag_threshold, df["flag_low_coherence"].sum(), len(df))
130	
131	    if df["cc_peak_mean"].notna().any():
132	        log.info("  cc_peak_mean:    %.3f ± %.3f",
133	                 df["cc_peak_mean"].mean(), df["cc_peak_mean"].std())
134	
135	    Path(args.out_csv).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
136	    df.to_csv(args.out_csv, index=False)
137	    log.info("Saved %s", args.out_csv)
138	
139	
140	if __name__ == "__main__":
